import MumfordLib.SingularSubdivisionMesh

/-!
# Vertex lists occurring in barycentric subdivision

The recursive subdivision of a vertex list consists of the cones from its
barycenter over the subdivisions of its faces. Every resulting vertex remains
in the original affine image, and each resulting simplex has vertex diameter
at most `n / (n + 1)` times an original pairwise vertex bound.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- The vertex lists obtained by recursively coning subdivisions of faces. -/
def barycentricSubdivisionVertices (m : ℕ) : (n : ℕ) →
    (Fin (n + 1) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) →
      Set (Fin (n + 1) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))
  | 0, v => {v}
  | n + 1, v => ⋃ i : Fin (n + 2),
      (fun w => Fin.cons (affineSimplexBarycenter v) w) ''
        barycentricSubdivisionVertices m n (v ∘ i.succAbove)

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-- Every subdivided vertex is a point of the original affine simplex. -/
theorem barycentricSubdivisionVertices_mem_range
    (v : Fin (n + 1) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))
    {w : Fin (n + 1) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))}
    (hw : w ∈ barycentricSubdivisionVertices m n v) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    w j ∈ Set.range (affineSimplexMap v) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have hw' : w = v := hw
      subst w
      exact ⟨stdSimplex.vertex j, affineSimplexMap_vertex v j⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hw with ⟨i, u, hu, rfl⟩
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
      · exact ⟨stdSimplex.barycenter, rfl⟩
      · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := ih (v ∘ i.succAbove) hu j
        exact ⟨stdSimplex.map i.succAbove t, by
          simpa only [affineSimplexMap_map, Fin.cons_succ] using ht⟩

/-- Every subdivided vertex lies in the convex hull of the original vertices. -/
theorem barycentricSubdivisionVertices_mem_convexHull
    (v : Fin (n + 1) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))
    {w : Fin (n + 1) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))}
    (hw : w ∈ barycentricSubdivisionVertices m n v) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (w j).val ∈ convexHull ℝ (Set.range fun i => (v i).val) := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := barycentricSubdivisionVertices_mem_range v hw j
  rw [← ht]
  exact affineSimplexMap_mem_convexHull v t

/-- One subdivision contracts every pairwise vertex bound by `n / (n + 1)`. -/
theorem barycentricSubdivisionVertices_dist_le
    (v : Fin (n + 1) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))
    {w : Fin (n + 1) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))}
    (hw : w ∈ barycentricSubdivisionVertices m n v) {D : ℝ}
    (hD₀ : 0 ≤ D) (hD : ∀ i j, dist (v i) (v j) ≤ D)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    dist (w i) (w j) ≤ (n : ℝ) / (n + 1) * D := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have hij : i = j := by omega
      simp [hij]
  | succ n ih =>
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hw with ⟨k, u, hu, rfl⟩
      have hB (a : Fin (n + 1)) :
          dist (affineSimplexBarycenter v) (u a) ≤
            ((n : ℝ) + 1) / (n + 1 + 1) * D := by
        obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := barycentricSubdivisionVertices_mem_range (v ∘ k.succAbove) hu a
        have h := affineSimplexBarycenter_dist_affineSimplexMap_le_card_ratio v hD
          (stdSimplex.map k.succAbove t)
        simpa only [affineSimplexMap_map, ht, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
          Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using h
      have hratio : (n : ℝ) / (n + 1) ≤ (n + 1) / (n + 1 + 1) := by
        apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr
        nlinarith
      have htail (a b : Fin (n + 1)) :
          dist (u a) (u b) ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) / (n + 1 + 1) * D :=
        (ih (v ∘ k.succAbove) hu (fun a b => hD (k.succAbove a) (k.succAbove b))
          a b).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hratio hD₀)
      simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun a => ?_) i
      · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun b => ?_) j
        · simpa only [Fin.cons_zero, dist_self] using
            mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (by positivity) (by positivity)) hD₀
        · simpa only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ] using hB b
      · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun b => ?_) j
        · simpa only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, dist_comm] using hB a
        · simpa only [Fin.cons_succ] using htail a b

end Mumford.Analytic
